title: Awesome Crunchy Italian Meat Torta Caprese
description: A rich and indulgent Italian dish featuring shredded meat and puff pastry, this torta caprese is a low-fat friendly meal option that is sure to satisfy your cravings. It combines the best of Italian flavors with a crunchy texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Stir in the tomato sauce, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spoon the meat mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the shredded mozzarella cheese over the top of the meat mixture.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with the olive oil and sprinkle with chopped fresh basil.
Place the torta caprese on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
